extension.summary: Dex Hub: a light, modern Kodi skin built around Dex Hub
Dex Hub: سكين كودي خفيف وعصري مبني حول Dex Hub
extension.description: Dex Hub's Home drawn by Kodi itself: a moving spotlight with trailers, your Dex Hub rows, collection animations, the video playing behind the Home on the whole page, your Nuvio profile, Dex Hub's title pages and grids. The video player, the settings pages and Kodi's dialogs are Arctic Fuse 3's, with ABUKARIM's CoreELEC player tools (PPI, Dolby Vision VS10) and his Arabic font sets.

رئيسية Dex Hub يرسمها كودي نفسه: بانر متحرك مع التريلر، صفوف Dex Hub، حركة المجموعات، الفيديو الذي يعمل في الخلفية على الصفحة كاملة، بروفايل Nuvio، صفحات الأعمال والكتالوجات. المشغل وصفحات الإعدادات ونوافذ كودي من Arctic Fuse 3، مع أدوات كورليك من ABUKARIM (PPI و Dolby Vision VS10) وخطوطه العربية.
extension.disclaimer: Based on Estuary (Team Kodi). The video player, settings pages and dialogs are Arctic Fuse 3's by jurialmunkey (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), from ABUKARIM's modified copy. Fonts: Inter with IBM Plex Sans Arabic, League Spartan, Font Awesome 6 Free (SIL Open Font License); the Arabic font sets come from that copy under their own terms.

extension.news: 3.19.1: installs whatever the order of the two zips (3.19.0 was refused before Dex Hub 5.10.141); with an older Dex Hub the colourful badges show until it is updated. 3.19.0: player badges from the Elite (official logos), Gold and Minimalist packs, each logo clean at one height with no plate behind it; badges from your own folder (replace any badge with an image of the same name); a badge page that previews each choice; unfocused rows fade lightly (85 percent) instead of turning grey, with a setting.
